title: job-1
prompt: Primary request: A cinematic editorial illustration about AI surveillance and hidden tracking. A laptop screen in the foreground displays a Claude Code terminal interface with the stylized Claude spark/asterisk logo glowing softly. Invisible ink-like digital fingerprints float from the keyboard and screen toward a distant cloud server. A small developer silhouette sits in the background. Moody dark blue and amber color palette, high contrast, subtle matrix-like code streams, magazine cover quality. No readable UI text, no real brand logos other than the stylized asterisk.
